latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Jinko Flight Search skill.
- Supports destination discovery based on user criteria (budget, activities, climate, etc.) via `find_destination`.
- Provides specific flight search and comparison between known cities or airports with `find_flight`.
- Includes flexible options: date ranges, stay length, cabin class, budget, and more.
- Handles city-to-multi-airport conversion and destination criteria mapping.
- Requires connection to the Jinko MCP server at https://mcp.gojinko.com for all operations.
